# CANDIDATE: WALK_FORWARD_OOS_2025Q3_2026Q2_VALIDATION

**Filed:** 2026-08-24  
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)  
**Type:** quality_gate  
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis

A 12-month training / 3-month testing walk-forward OOS from 2025-Q3 to 2026-Q2 will reveal whether the engine's edge is robust and not overfit to a specific regime. Simultaneously, validating real-fills on the three J anchor days (4/29, 5/01, 5/04) against BS-sim ensures simulator fidelity; we require ≤20% P&L difference to trust backtested edge estimates.

## Mechanism

- **Walk-forward OOS:** For each chronological fold, train on the preceding 12 months (e.g., 2025-Q3→2026-Q2 uses 2024-Q3→2025-Q2 as train) and test on the next 3 months. Compute edge_capture (sum of engine P&L on J winners minus clipped losses on J losers) and aggregate Sharpe across folds.  
- **Real-fills validation:** For each of the three J anchor days, replay the strategy's exact entries/exits using cached OPRA bid/ask with a slippage model (mid‑price ± half‑spread, latency‑adjusted). Compare total P&L to BS‑sim; compute percent difference.  
- **Pass criteria:** edge_capture > 771 (50% of max 1542), aggregate Sharpe ≥ 0.70, and average |P&L_diff| ≤ 20% across the three J days.

## OP-20 disclosures

1. **Account-size assumption:** qty=28 requires $25K+ account; $1K paper account ≈14% of headline P&L (per OP‑20 scaling).  
2. **Sample bias:** 4 folds (2025‑Q3, 2025‑Q4, 2026‑Q1, 2026‑Q2) each with 12‑month train / 3‑month test, chronological selection. Overfit risk mitigated by requiring OOS Sharpe ≥0.70 and sub‑window stability; still moderate risk if regime shifts within folds.  
3. **Out-of-sample:** NEEDS-OOS (walk‑forward OOS test will be executed as part of this candidate; result pending).  
4. **Real-fills:** NEEDS-REAL-FILLS (validation on top‑3 J days will be performed; result pending).  
5. **Failure modes:**  
   - Worst day: a large‑volatility gap could trigger catastrophic −50% premium stop on multiple contracts.  
   - Max drawdown: estimated from historical equity curve; if >30% of equity in any fold, candidate fails.  
   - Blow‑up scenario: persistent volatility regime change causing stop‑losses to fire frequently, turning edge negative; mitigated by requiring positive edge_capture and Sharpe.  
6. **Concentration:** Will be disclosed post‑test; if top‑5 days contribute >100% of P&L, candidate will be flagged for concentration risk.

## Pre-merge gate

- Gym validators (all unit tests in `backtest/tests/` must PASS).  
- Walk‑forward OOS test must pass: edge_capture > 771, aggregate Sharpe ≥ 0.70, sub‑window stability (no two consecutive quarters with negative per‑month Sharpe).  
- Real‑fills validation on 4/29, 5/01, 5/04 must show ≤20% average P&L difference vs BS‑sim.  
- No regression on anchor days (byte‑identical behavior on J winners/losers as measured by a dry‑run).

5 / 10 -- pending execution of the walk‑forward OOS and real‑fills validation; based on prior similar validations (e.g., V14E_PARAM_SWEEP_26K) which cleared OOS and real‑fills gates, but we have not yet run this specific test.
